title: A New Era for Hollywood: Paramount and Warner Bros. Complete Massive Merger
subtitle: The creation of Skydance brings together legendary film studios and major news networks in a $111 billion deal.

summary.en: Paramount has officially finished its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The new media company, named Skydance, is led by billionaire investor David Ellison. This merger combines iconic film studios, streaming services, and major news outlets like CNN and CBS. While the deal is now complete, it faced significant legal challenges from states concerned about competition. Critics remain worried about the influence of the new leadership on independent news reporting.
summary.zh: 派拉蒙已正式完成對華納兄弟探索價值一千一百一十億美元的收購案。這家名為「天空之舞」的新媒體公司由億萬富翁投資人大衛·艾利森領導。此次合併整合了指標性的電影製片廠、串流服務以及 CNN 與 CBS 等主要新聞媒體。儘管交易現已完成，但過程中面臨了各州因擔憂市場競爭而提出的重大法律挑戰。評論家仍對新領導層對獨立新聞報導的潛在影響感到憂心。

paragraphs.en: A new chapter in the history of entertainment began this Tuesday as Paramount officially completed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The deal creates a massive new media company called Skydance. This merger brings together two of the oldest and most famous film studios in the world, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Pictures, under one roof. According to The Guardian Business, the move consolidates some of the most recognizable names in media, including HBO Max, CBS News, and CNN.
paragraphs.zh: 娛樂產業歷史的新篇章於本週二揭開序幕，派拉蒙（Paramount）正式完成對華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery）價值一千一百一十億美元的收購案。這筆交易催生了一家名為「天空之舞」（Skydance）的龐大新媒體公司。此次合併將全球歷史最悠久、最負盛名的兩大電影製片廠——派拉蒙影業（Paramount Pictures）與華納兄弟影業（Warner Bros. Pictures）納入同一旗下。根據《衛報商業版》（The Guardian Business）報導，此舉整合了媒體界最具辨識度的品牌，包括 HBO Max、CBS 新聞（CBS News）及 CNN。

paragraphs.en: David Ellison, the son of billionaire tech mogul Larry Ellison, will lead the new company as chairman and CEO. He will work alongside Ynon Kreiz, the former head of Mattel, who will serve as co-executive. In a public statement, David Ellison described the merger as a historic day for the industry. He stated that the goal was to create a stronger competitor with the resources and reach to tell great stories on every platform for audiences everywhere. According to Deutsche Welle, the new company plans to combine its streaming services, Paramount+ and HBO Max, and aims to save around $6 billion in costs over the next three years.
paragraphs.zh: 億萬富翁科技大亨賴瑞·艾利森（Larry Ellison）之子大衛·艾利森（David Ellison）將擔任這家新公司的董事長兼執行長。他將與曾任美泰兒（Mattel）負責人的伊農·克雷茲（Ynon Kreiz）共事，後者將擔任共同執行長。大衛·艾利森在公開聲明中形容此次合併對該產業而言是歷史性的一天。他表示，目標是打造一個更強大的競爭者，具備足夠的資源與影響力，能在各種平台上為全球觀眾講述精彩故事。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，新公司計畫整合旗下的串流服務 Paramount+ 與 HBO Max，並目標在未來三年內節省約六十億美元的成本。

paragraphs.en: This merger was not easy to achieve. It faced months of legal battles and intense scrutiny from regulators. California, New York, and 10 other states sued Paramount, arguing that the deal would hurt competition and lead to fewer choices for viewers. To settle these legal issues, Skydance agreed to specific rules. As reported by NPR Business, the company must release at least 30 films and over 180 television shows each year. Additionally, a trustee will monitor the company to ensure it follows the terms of the settlement. Rob Bonta, the California attorney general, stated that while the settlement allows the merger to proceed, it does not mean his office supports the consolidation of such essential markets.
paragraphs.zh: 這場合併案的達成並非易事，經歷了數月的法律攻防與監管機構的嚴格審查。加州、紐約州及其他十個州對派拉蒙提起訴訟，主張此交易將損害市場競爭，並導致觀眾的選擇減少。為了平息這些法律爭議，天空之舞同意遵守特定規範。據美國公共廣播電台商業版（NPR Business）報導，該公司每年必須發行至少三十部電影與超過一百八十部電視節目。此外，將有一名受託人監督公司，以確保其遵守和解條款。加州檢察長羅伯·邦塔（Rob Bonta）表示，儘管和解協議允許合併案進行，但這並不代表他的辦公室支持這種關鍵市場的整合。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the business side, the merger has sparked serious concerns about the future of news reporting. Both CNN and CBS News are now part of the Skydance empire. Many critics worry about the political influence of the Ellison family, who are known to be allies of President Trump. Jessica Gonzalez, an attorney with the nonprofit group Free Press, told NPR that she is concerned about the potential for the new owners to use their power to influence or censor the news. These fears are partly based on previous actions at CBS News, where David Ellison appointed Bari Weiss, a former writer with little television experience, to lead the network. Since that appointment, the network has faced accusations of bias.
paragraphs.zh: 除了商業層面，此次合併也引發了對新聞報導未來的嚴重擔憂。CNN 與 CBS 新聞現在皆隸屬於天空之舞帝國。許多評論家擔心艾利森家族的政治影響力，該家族被視為川普（Donald Trump）總統的盟友。非營利組織「自由新聞」（Free Press）的律師潔西卡·岡薩雷斯（Jessica Gonzalez）向美國公共廣播電台表示，她擔心新東家可能會利用權力來影響或審查新聞。這些恐懼部分源於 CBS 新聞先前的舉措，當時大衛·艾利森任命了缺乏電視經驗的前作家芭莉·魏斯（Bari Weiss）領導該電視網。自該任命以來，該電視網便面臨偏頗的指控。

paragraphs.en: Despite these concerns, leadership at the news networks has expressed confidence in the new arrangement. CNN’s CEO, Mark Thompson, announced that he would remain in his role. He told staff that he had spoken with the new leadership and believes they understand the importance of independent news. According to The Guardian Business, Thompson said he has real confidence that the new owners will support the practice of independent journalism that CNN has always stood for.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在這些擔憂，新聞網的領導層仍對新的安排表示信心。CNN 執行長馬克·湯普森（Mark Thompson）宣布他將留任。他告訴員工，他已與新領導層溝通過，並相信他們理解獨立新聞的重要性。根據《衛報商業版》報導，湯普森表示他確實有信心，新東家將支持 CNN 一貫堅持的獨立新聞報導實踐。

paragraphs.en: For the film industry, the merger marks a major shift. Skydance now controls a massive library of 15,000 films, including famous titles like The Godfather, the Harry Potter series, and the DC Universe. However, the change in ownership has also meant that some top leaders are leaving. Michael De Luca and Pamela Abdy, who previously led Warner Bros. Pictures, are no longer with the company. As the new company begins its work, the industry and the public will be watching closely to see how these changes affect both the movies we watch and the news we receive. While the deal is now a reality, the debate over whether such large media mergers are good for the public is far from over.
paragraphs.zh: 對於電影產業而言，此次合併標誌著重大的轉變。天空之舞現在掌控了包含一萬五千部電影的龐大片庫，其中包括《教父》（The Godfather）、《哈利波特》（Harry Potter）系列以及 DC 宇宙（DC Universe）等知名作品。然而，經營權的更迭也意味著一些高層主管的離職。先前領導華納兄弟影業的麥可·德·盧卡（Michael De Luca）與潘蜜拉·艾比迪（Pamela Abdy）已不再任職於該公司。隨著新公司展開運作，產業界與大眾將密切關注這些變動如何影響我們觀看的電影與接收的新聞。雖然這筆交易已成定局，但關於此類大型媒體合併是否對公眾有利的辯論，遠未結束。

keyTerms.definitionEn: In the same building or under the same organization/management.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 在同一個屋簷下，指在同一間公司或機構管理之下。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「在同一個屋頂下」，這裡指兩家公司合併為一。文中：This merger brings together two of the oldest and most famous film studios in the world, Paramount Pictures and Warner Bros. Pictures, under one roof.
這是一個學術與新聞常見詞，但在日常口語較少見，容易與其他類似拼寫的詞混淆。文中：It faced months of legal battles and intense scrutiny from regulators.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To support or represent a particular set of values or principles.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 代表、支持（某種價值或原則）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「忍受」，這裡指堅持或代表某種價值觀。文中：Thompson said he has real confidence that the new owners will support the practice of independent journalism that CNN has always stood for.

previousArticles.summaryEn: Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery have officially completed a $111 billion merger to form a new media company called Skydance. Led by David Ellison, the organization now controls major film studios, streaming services, and news outlets like CNN and CBS. While the company promises to create more content, the deal faced significant legal challenges from state officials concerned about market competition. Critics also worry about the influence of the new leadership on independent news reporting. A legal settlement requires the company to maintain specific production levels and editorial independence for its news divisions.

quiz.question: What specific condition was imposed on Skydance to resolve the legal challenges against the merger?

options.A: They must sell off CNN and CBS News to avoid media monopolies.
options.B: They are required to produce a minimum number of films and television shows annually.
options.C: They must pay a $6 billion fine to the states of California and New York.
options.D: They are prohibited from combining their streaming services for three years.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，為了化解訴訟，Skydance 同意了特定條款，即每年必須發行至少 30 部電影和超過 180 部電視節目。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未要求出售新聞機構；選項 C 錯誤，60 億美元是預計節省的成本，而非罰款；選項 D 錯誤，公司反而計畫合併串流服務，而非被禁止。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the public be skeptical about the future of news integrity under the new ownership?

options.A: Because the new CEO has announced plans to shut down CBS News.
options.B: Because the company intends to merge CNN and CBS News into a single channel.
options.C: Because the owners have political ties and a history of controversial hiring practices.
options.D: Because the regulators have officially declared that the merger will destroy independent journalism.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，評論家擔心 Ellison 家族與川普的政治盟友關係，加上之前任命缺乏電視經驗的 Bari Weiss 導致偏見指控，這些資訊暗示了公眾對新聞公正性的擔憂。選項 A 與 B 在文中皆未提及；選項 D 錯誤，雖然監管機構對合併表示擔憂，但並未做出「將摧毀新聞業」的正式宣告。

quiz.question: In the phrase 'the move consolidates some of the most recognizable names in media,' what does 'consolidates' mean?

options.A: Combines several things into a single, more effective whole.
options.B: Carefully examines the quality of various media products.
options.C: Separates large companies into smaller, independent branches.
options.D: Promotes the popularity of specific television programs.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在第一段中，consolidates 的意思是將多個實體合併在一起。文中提到將 Paramount 和 Warner Bros. 旗下的多個媒體品牌整合進 Skydance 這家新公司，因此 A 是正確意義。選項 B 是 scrutiny 的意思；選項 C 與原意相反，是拆分而非合併；選項 D 則與整併企業的商業行為無關。

quiz.question: Which statement best summarizes the overall message of the article?

options.A: The merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. is primarily a financial success that will save billions.
options.B: The new Skydance company will focus exclusively on film production while leaving news to independent outlets.
options.C: The merger creates a media giant, but it faces significant legal, ethical, and operational challenges.
options.D: The Ellison family has successfully taken control of the media industry to promote their political agenda.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章全面探討了合併案的背景（商業合併）、法律障礙（訴訟與監管）、新聞倫理擔憂（政治影響與偏見）以及對影視產業的未來影響，涵蓋了正反兩面的觀點。選項 A 太過狹隘，只提到財務；選項 B 與事實不符；選項 D 屬於過度推論，文中僅提到擔憂，並未證實這是合併的唯一目的。
